LanguageData.APM_Mech_Gazer.label: Gazer
LanguageData.APM_Mech_Gazer.description: A different application of hellsphere technology resulted in the Gazer, a mechanoid clearly identified by its primary ocular beam emitter. This weapon is strong enough that the gazer must lock itself in place and divert all motor functions to stabilizing itself when firing. Even then, a significant charge time is required. The resultant beam can obliterate anything in front of it, even doing decent damage to structures. When pressed in close quarters, the Gazer can instead discharge the accumulated energy outward as a violent shockwave that hurls attackers back and disrupts nearby mechanized targets.
LanguageData.APM_Mech_Tinker.label: Tinker
LanguageData.APM_Mech_Tinker.description: The tinker is a support mechanoid built to repair same-faction buildings and mechanoids. It cannot construct new structures, but it can project a defensive matrix onto allies and blind enemies with a targeted laser.

LanguageData.APM_Solus.label: solus
LanguageData.APM_Solus.description: A reinforced gamma-ray emitter capable of producing a dense, concentrated ball of destructive energy. As the ball passes by targets, it discharges into them and ignites its surroundings. It is a particularly devastating weapon against groups of enemies. The massive energy output requires stabilization protocols to prevent self-damage.
